note: Single source of truth for every tunable parameter and its validation range. src/*.c consume the generated header build/generated/kws_parameter_limits.h; the python tools read this file directly. tools/gen_parameter_limits.py --check verifies both sides agree.

layers.L0: model-bound: packaged in .kwm, not changeable by a product
layers.L1: firmware constant: compile-time macro, change requires rebuild plus regression
layers.L2: product config: kws_config_t field, change invalidates calibrated keyword thresholds
layers.L3: field policy: per-keyword KWKP v3 record field, change requires rerunning calibration

min_speech_dbfs.summary: Speech gate applied to the 400-sample frame energy of the post-AFE PCM.

token_boost.summary: DEPRECATED / INEFFECTIVE. Retained for source and ABI compatibility. It is added once per trie depth, so it is a constant offset on the search score; emitted confidence uses exp(acoustic/depth) and the retention gate subtracts token_boost*depth, which cancels it exactly. See docs/RUNTIME_CONFIG.md.

state_retention.summary: Per-frame retention factor applied to a live keyword prefix on a speech frame.

refractory_ms.summary: Suppression window after an emitted detection, to stop immediate retrigger.

external_vad_threshold.summary: Decision threshold applied to the external VAD probability supplied through frame metadata.

threshold.summary: Per-keyword acceptance threshold on the emitted confidence.

min_trailing_blanks.summary: Blank-separated frames required before a held terminal may fire.

priority.summary: Arbitration rank. Higher wins. Ties are resolved by depth and then confidence, so duplicate ranks are allowed and deterministic.

grace_frames.summary: Hold window for the grace prefix policy.

KWS_SILENCE_RETENTION_LOG.summary: Per-frame retention factor applied to a live keyword prefix on a non-speech frame.

KWS_MIN_PATH_RETENTION_LOG.summary: Abandonment budget for a partial prefix: about 45 non-speech frames (0.90 s) or 259 speech frames (5.17 s) at a 20 ms hop.

KWS_ROOT_START_LOGIT_MARGIN.summary: A non-dominant token may start a keyword only within this logit margin of the top token, about a 1.65x probability ratio.

KWS_FUZZY_CHILD_RETENTION_COST_LOG.summary: Cost charged for a fuzzy child advance: 51.6 percent of the abandonment budget, so two such advances can never complete a keyword.

KWS_DECODER_BOUNDARY_RESET_INACTIVE_FRAM.summary: Consecutive speech-inactive decoder frames before stale keyword-prefix history is cleared. At the current 20 ms hop, 12 frames is 240 ms. Acoustic RNN/frontend state is not reset.

KWS_PCEN_DELTA.summary: PCEN-lite bias under the square root.

KWS_LOGMEL_COMPRESSION.summary: logmel compression applied as log1p(gain * energy).

KWS_FEATURE_NORMALIZATION.summary: Scale applied to the mean-normalised feature vector.
